## Why This Is Asked
Tests must handle real-time data streams and non-determinism in UI state. This task evaluates how a candidate mocks live feeds, asserts dynamic UI updates, and ensures deterministic outcomes during checkout.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time UI updates via WebSocket mocks
- Idempotent handling of duplicate events
- Test data isolation and deterministic seeds
- Cross‑device (desktop/mobile) accessibility checks

## Code Example
```javascript
// Playwright pseudo-setup
const priceFeed = new MockWebSocketFeed();
await page.goto('/cart');
priceFeed.emit({id: 'p1', price: 19.99});
priceFeed.emit({id: 'p1', price: 17.99}); // real-time update
// assert subtotals and total reflect latest price
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you reproduce flakey price updates in CI and ensure determinism?
- How would you extend this to multiple concurrent price feeds across regions?
